body: techcrunch.com: The iPhone maker appears to be building agents that can compete with the likes of Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude, and OpenAI Dots.

theverge.com: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg, which says Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI assistant. [ ]
